profile.name: LEONI光纤开关
profile.description: 一种多通道光纤切换设备，用于在多个光纤通道之间选择当前连通的通路，常用于光学实验、光路切换和自动化测试系统中的信号路由。
profile.description_en: A multi-channel fiber switch used to select the active connection among multiple fiber channels. It is commonly used in optical experiments, light-path switching, and automated test setups for signal routing.
